title: 基于RAG和跨模型多数投票的ChatGPT生物医学关联生成与验证评估协议
summary: 提出一个评估ChatGPT生成疾病中心生物医学关联能力的协议，包括使用生物医学本体验证实体、通过文献验证关联、自一致性策略评估生成可靠性，以及利用RAG和开源LLM进行语义验证以暴露幻觉。
summary_en: Presents a protocol to evaluate ChatGPT's ability to generate disease-centric biomedical associations, including entity validation via ontologies, literature verification, self-consistency strategy, and RAG-powered semantic verification with open-source LLMs to expose hallucination.
